name.en: Adjustable leg with screw-on plate, pilot holes (generic)

source: Generic leg with a base plate screwed to the underside of the bottom: four pilot holes on a square around the leg centre. The hole pattern (plate_cc), pilot Ø and depth, the adjusting range and the foot Ø are TYPICAL PLACEHOLDER VALUES, not taken from any manufacturer's data sheet: measure the plate of the leg you use and set them before machining. For a plate screwed on without pre-drilling use the item without drilling (generic-leg-100-screwed).
